name: Tetracaine
aliases: Amethocaine, Dicaine, Medihaler-Tetracaine, Metraspray, Pontocaine, TET150, Tetracaína, Tétracaïne
summary: Tetracaine, also known as amethocaine, is an ester local anesthetic used to numb the eyes, nose, or throat. It may also be applied to the skin before starting intravenous therapy to decrease pain from the procedure. Typically it is applied as a liquid to the area. Onset of effects when used in the eyes is within 30 seconds and last for less than 15 minutes.

pharmacology.text: In biomedical research, tetracaine is used to alter the function of calcium release channels (ryanodine receptors) that control the release of calcium from intracellular stores. Tetracaine is an allosteric blocker of channel function. At low concentrations, tetracaine causes an initial inhibition of spontaneous calcium release events, while at high concentrations, tetracaine blocks release completely.

uses.text: Tetracaine, also known as amethocaine, is an ester local anesthetic used to numb the eyes, nose, or throat. Tetracaine is in the ester-type local anesthetic family of medications. Tetracaine was patented in 1930 and came into medical use in 1941.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include a brief period of burning at the site of use.

summaryZh: 丁卡因，又稱Amethocaine），是一種酯類局部麻醉藥，主要用於眼部、鼻部或喉嚨的麻醉。在進行靜脈注射（通常在兒科護理、長期治療，或是特殊部位）前，也可將其塗抹於皮膚上，以減輕穿刺造成的疼痛。通常是以液體形式塗抹於目標區域。當用於眼部時，藥效會在30秒內發揮作用，且持續時間不到15分鐘。
